API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivileged Approval ManagementGets all configured privileged approvals for the specified customer.
Gets all configured privileged approvals for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/approval

Gets all configured privileged approvals for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
sortBy
string

The sort string used to support sorting on the given field for the API.

sortdir
string

Possible values: [ASC, DESC]

Specifies the sort direction (i.e., ascending or descending order).

microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

403

OK
